core_obligations: Set A = O_{X,xi}; dim(A) = dim(X) - dim(Z) (cited); I, J the trace ideals of V and W.
Multiplicity 1 gives length(A/I+J) = 1, hence I + J = m; the mod-m^2 images sum to m/m^2 (equality everywhere by proper intersection).

Choose f_1..f_a in I, g_1..g_b in J lifting a basis of m/m^2; regular system of parameters and regular sequence (cited CM lemma); A/(f) regular of dimension dim(X)-dim(V) forces I = (f) (dimension drops otherwise, cited).
Koszul complex resolves A/I (cited); Tor computes as Koszul cohomology on A/J with a regular system of parameters, giving only H_0 = A/(I+J) = kappa.
proof_roadmap: m/m^2 bookkeeping + parameter lifting + Koszul resolution + Tor collapse
difficulty_reason: 2171B executed end to end: local ring at the generic point, dimension formula, mod-m^2 linear algebra with equality everywhere from multiplicity one and properness, regular system of parameters, Koszul resolution of A/I, Tor computation collapsing to H_0 = kappa; 'similarly' is the legitimate symmetry for J.
